selection_rule: Candidate subjects and canonical answers are frozen before Bazel non-stale-conflict source acquisition. Candidates are evaluated in listed rank order. The first four eligible candidates fill bpd-bazel-nc-01..04. Eligibility requires four unique Bazel-authored authoritative source files, at least three human-authored primary or normative required sources spanning at least three producer allocations, an exact same-key conflicting claim with required-evidence span no greater than 30 days, exact ordered-answer support, and no exact source-byte reuse with any previously selected confirmatory case. A candidate may be rejected only for a source-integrity or frozen-design eligibility failure; treatment or evaluator outcomes may not be observed or used.
